title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - WaterInfrastructure
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/WaterInfrastructure. A water infrastructure is the set of facilities, services, and installations needed for water management. Subclass of geo:Feature, saref:FeatureOfInterest and s4syst:System per the SAREF4WATR ontology (imported classes, not separately modeled). This is the root of the SAREF4WATR infrastructure hierarchy: DistributionSystem, StorageInfrastructure, MonitoringInfrastructure (and its own subclass GaugingStation), TreatmentPlant and HydroelectricPowerPlant all subclass this class and inherit, without repeating, its base properties (id/type/dateCreated/dateModified/source/dataProvider/location) plus isDesignedFor and isIntendedFor. Own properties: isDesignedFor, isIntendedFor.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'WaterInfrastructure'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: Geoproperty. Geojson reference to the item. Maps to geo:hasGeometry in the SAREF4WATR/GeoSPARQL ontology.

isDesignedFor.description: Property. The kind(s) of water this infrastructure is designed for, drawn from the SAREF4WATR WaterKind taxonomy. Maps to s4watr:isDesignedFor.

isIntendedFor.description: Property. The intended use(s) of this infrastructure, drawn from the SAREF4WATR WaterUse taxonomy. Maps to s4watr:isIntendedFor.
